svg.title: Preparation and node output workflow
svg.desc: A rapid settings edit retains the last installation as a preview while one worker prepares the latest demand. A successful current preparation is installed through the runtime consumer; a current preparation failure selects visible error output.

g.text: loop [request A, then B and C while A runs]
loop [final A starts C; final C permits build]
retain Z preview; prepare only if idle
prepare C / build C / current error
